title: The orbit categories ]X/G[ and [X/G]
body_html:
The orbit categories $\,]X/G[\,$ and $\,[X/G]\,$

Let $G$ act cellularly on the cell complex $X$ (Locally finite regular CW complex with cellular G-action). The $G$-action combines with the face-order to produce two related categories. (These are the small "quotient stack" $[X/G]$ of $X$ by $G$ in the categorical language; we follow the paper's notation $]X/G[$, $[X/G]$.)

Definition

Definition ($]X/G[$). The orbit category $]X/G[$ has:

  • objects: cells of $X$;
  • morphisms: $\Hom_{]X/G[}(E, E') := {g \in G : g \cdot E \preceq E'}$;
  • composition: $g_2 \circ g_1 := g_2 g_1$ (well-typed because $(g_2 g_1) \cdot E = g_2 \cdot (g_1 \cdot E) \preceq g_2 \cdot E' \preceq E''$ using cellularity of the $G$-action);
  • identity: $\mathbf 1 : E \to E$ from $\mathbf 1 \cdot E = E \preceq E$.

We write $g : E \to E'$ for the morphism corresponding to $g \in \Hom_{]X/G[}(E, E')$.

Definition ($[X/G]$). $[X/G] := \,]X/G[^{\mathrm{op}}$.

Inversion $g \mapsto g^{-1}$ on $G$ gives a bijection $\Hom_{]X/G[}(E, E') \cong \Hom_{[X/G]}(E', E)$, so equivalently $$ \Hom_{[X/G]}(E', E) = \{g \in G : E \preceq g \cdot E'\}. $$

Trivial-group specialisation. For $G = \{e\}$, $]X/\{e\}[ \,=\, ]X[$ and $[X/\{e\}] = [X]$ ([[node:cellular_categories.category_jXk]]).

Endomorphisms are stabilisers

An endomorphism $g \in \Hom_{]X/G[}(E, E)$ has $g \cdot E \preceq E$; because the $G$-action preserves dimension (Cellular G-action on an abstract cell complex) and $\dim$ is strictly monotone on proper faces (Abstract cell complex), $g \cdot E = E$. Hence $$ \End_{]X/G[}(E) \;\cong\; \Stab_G(E) \qquad \text{as monoids}, $$ and dually $\End_{[X/G]}(E) \cong \Stab_G(E)$.

The rest — how functors on $]X/G[$ (resp.\ $[X/G]$) recover $G$-equivariant sheaves (resp.\ cosheaves), and how the above endomorphism identification realises the stalk actions — is G-equivariant (co)sheaves as functors on ]X/G[ resp. [X/G].

Lean formalization

Only $]X/G[$ carries a fresh Lean type; $[X/G]$ is (OrbitCat G X)ᵒᵖ.

abbrev OrbitCat (G X : Type*) : Type _ := X
def Mor (E E' : OrbitCat G X) : Type _ :=
  {g : G // g • (E : X) ≤ (E' : X)}
scoped instance category : Category (OrbitCat G X) where
  Hom := Mor
  id  := Mor.id
  comp := Mor.comp

Design points:

  • OrbitCat G X is an abbrev for X, keeping all MulAction G X / PartialOrder X / AbstractCellComplex X instances visible without transport.
  • Mor E E' is a Subtype of G (not a bespoke structure) so its universe matches G's, satisfying Category's constraints.
  • The instance is scoped so it does not clash with X's own Preorder-derived category.

(A downstream limitation of this abbrev choice — two competing Category X instances collide in mixed contexts such as GCosheaf.toFunctor — is discussed in G-equivariant (co)sheaves as functors on ]X/G[ resp. [X/G]. It affects downstream packaging, not the definition itself.)

The endomorphism–stabiliser identification comes packaged three ways for downstream convenience:

def endMorEquivStabilizer (E : OrbitCat G X) :
    Mor E E ≃ MulAction.stabilizer G (E : X)         -- Equiv
def endMulEquivStabilizer (E : OrbitCat G X) :
    End E ≃* MulAction.stabilizer G (E : X)          -- MulEquiv
def endToStabilizer (E : OrbitCat G X) :
    End E →* MulAction.stabilizer G (E : X)          -- MonoidHom

The ≃* upgrade needs care with CategoryTheory.End's convention $x * y = y \circ x$ (opposite of standard group multiplication); endMulEquivStabilizer handles that.

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.OrbitCat.Mor
lean_refs.signature:
def Mor (E E' : OrbitCat G X) : Type _ :=
  {g : G // g • (E : X) ≤ (E' : X)}

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.OrbitCat.Mor.id
lean_refs.signature:
def Mor.id (E : OrbitCat G X) : Mor E E :=
  ⟨1, show (1 : G) • (E : X) ≤ (E : X) by rw [one_smul]⟩

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.OrbitCat.Mor.comp
lean_refs.signature:
def Mor.comp {E E' E'' : OrbitCat G X} (α : Mor E E') (β : Mor E' E'') :
    Mor E E''

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.OrbitCat.category
lean_refs.signature:
scoped instance category : Category (OrbitCat G X) where
  Hom E E' := Mor E E'
  id E := Mor.id E
  comp α β := Mor.comp α β
  id_comp _ := Subtype.ext (mul_one _)
  comp_id _ := Subtype.ext (one_mul _)
  assoc _ _ _ := Subtype.ext (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.OrbitCat.endMorEquivStabilizer
lean_refs.signature:
def endMorEquivStabilizer (E : OrbitCat G X) :
    Mor E E ≃ MulAction.stabilizer G (E : X) where
  toFun α := ⟨α.val, by
    show α.val • (E : X) = E
    by_contra h_ne
    have h_lt : AbstractCellComplex.dim (α.val • (E : X)) <
        AbstractCellComplex.dim (E : X) :=
      AbstractCellComplex.dim_lt α.property h_ne
    have h_eq : AbstractCellComplex.dim (α.val • (E : X)) =
        AbstractCellComplex.dim (E : X) :=
      GCellComplex.smul_dim α.val E
    omega⟩
  invFun k := ⟨k.val, by
    show k.val • (E : X) ≤ (E : X)
    rw [(k.property : k.val • (E : X) = E)]⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.OrbitCat.endMulEquivStabilizer
lean_refs.signature:
def endMulEquivStabilizer (E : OrbitCat G X) :
    End E ≃* MulAction.stabilizer G (E : X) where
  toEquiv := endMorEquivStabilizer E
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl
